rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired structure and blocks on subject (~subject + condition) with a Wald test on the condition coefficient and control set as the explicit reference level, which matches the reference exactly. QC precedes modeling with blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes colored by both condition and subject, sample distance heatmap, and library sizes; the outlier policy is stated (report only, no dropping at this stage) though it is passive rather than specifying what would trigger action. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, justified as the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, raw integers go straight into DESeq2 with median-of-ratios size factors and an explicit prohibition on pre-normalization or length correction. FDR is BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage for reported effects, Cook's-distance NAs distinguished from filtering NAs, and a p-value histogram check. Enrichment uses the full ranked list on the Wald statistic with named, versioned collections, a 15-500 size window, tested-gene universe and leading-edge reporting; the final report step names method, versions, design, contrast, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, diagnostics, and n=5 discovery-stage caveats.
